subject: POC kickoff — propose staggered micro-sessions & load window
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orbitai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — our exec conflict, proposal to split session

Hi Mina —

Thanks for scheduling the hands-on POC next week. We just had a late exec meeting land on the same slot (customer COO needs to be in a different call), so we won't be able to commit a full 3-hour block as planned.

Rather than cancel entirely, would Redwood be open to delivering the POC as three staggered micro-sessions (3 x ~45 minutes) over two days, plus an asynchronous prompt-review document for our team to try in-between? That would let our engineering leads attend at least one hands-on slice and still get coverage.

A couple of asks from our side if you can confirm: 
- Can you run a short load test during one of the sessions (burst of ~75 concurrent chat sessions for 8–10 minutes) to validate routing/kv cache behavior?
- Will the demo prompts and expected outputs be shared in advance (we prefer a short checklist so our privacy folks can sign off)?

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Aug 24: 10:00–12:00 (we can take a 45m block starting 10:15)
- Wed Aug 25: 14:00–17:00 (happy for evening slice)

If those don't work, we're flexible to move to the following week. Also, attaching our internal agenda draft for context.

Attachments: Orbit-PoC-Agenda-v1.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Platform
OrbitAI
elena.morales@orbitai.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orbitai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — our exec conflict, proposal to split session

Thanks for the note, Elena — appreciate you proposing an alternative. Splitting into micro-sessions is a sensible approach and we've done similar modular POCs before. Happy to accommodate.

Quick answers to the asks:
- Load test: yes — we can run a focused burst of 75–100 concurrent chat sessions for 10 minutes. We'll need a 30-minute pre-check window to validate client tokens and routing and a short cooldown after.
- Prompts: we'll share a concise prompt pack + expected outputs 48 hours before the first micro-session so your compliance team can review.

Proposed micro-session cadence (PDT):
- Micro 1: Tue Aug 24, 10:15–11:00 — architecture & prompt walkthrough (Marissa leads)
- Micro 2: Tue Aug 24, 11:15–12:00 — routing & integration Q&A (Dylan leads)
- Micro 3: Wed Aug 25, 14:30–15:15 — load test & performance observations (Marissa + infra)

If that looks OK, I'll send calendar invites. We can also split them across two mornings if you prefer (we left a 15-minute buffer between micro1 and micro2 in case someone needs to jump).

I've attached an updated POC agenda and our proposed load test plan for your review.

Attachments: POC-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF); redwood-loadtest-plan.txt (TXT)

Next steps:
- Confirm the above cadence or suggest alternate windows by EOD Monday
- I'll create calendar invites and a shared Drive folder for the prompt pack and test artifacts

Thanks — looking forward to running this with the OrbitAI team.

—
Mina Haddad
Principal Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Target: get calendar invites out today so Orbit can circulate to their execs.

Thanks, that schedule works for our leads. We've confirmed internal availability for the Tuesday slots; we'll block Wed 14:30–15:15 for the load test as well.

- We'll need a simple SOW template before the first session so our legal team has a starting point. If you have a basic SOW, please attach.

Elena
